code='''def transform(grid):
    sep = next(i for i, v in enumerate(grid[0]) if v not in (0, 3, 6) and all(row[i] == v for row in grid))
    left = [row[:sep] for row in grid]
    right = [row[sep+1:sep+1+sep] for row in grid]
    return [[2 if left[r][c] != 0 and (c >= len(right[r]) or right[r][c] != 0) else 0 for c in range(sep)] for r in range(len(grid))]
'''
